frequently asked questions (faq)

Why this Solana mixer?

We at SOLANA-MIXER.ORG value privacy and efficiency.

  • ✔ No need to connect wallets.
  • ✔ No need to keep notes. Direct deposits and withdrawals, 24/24.
  • ✔ No need to mix fixed amounts like 10 SOL or multiples of 10 SOL.
  • ✔ Deposit any amount you want to mix, straight from your personal wallet or CEX.
  • ✔ Get started right away and see for yourself.

What is NO KYC?

Off course, when we say NO KYC, this means no form of identification is required before using our services. Access for all, no reason to dox yourself... after all, it is a cryptomixer to protect your privacy.

How do I confirm my transaction?

One confirmation stands for a quick and instant (depending on the chosen timeframe) service. Off course, a transaction will be received and processed faster depending on the Solana fee that you, the customer, used.

What is the fixed fee?

How are you able to offer this service for free? We don't, because there is a fixed fee taken out of the amount that you mix. For example, if you transfer 15 or more SOL, it will cost 2% of that amount to process. All amounts lower than 15 SOL will cost 3% to mix. Compared to other mixers, this is still cheaper.

Are there limits?

Off course there are... but we have higher mixing limits than most mixers. Some of them have a max transaction value that is not very high. We allow up to a maximum of 2500 SOL per transaction to service customers who want to mix larger amounts.

Is there a minimum?

Yes, the minimum amount to mix is 5 SOL.
